about: [O3] the gangs: a three on a Tenements corner, three men not one; I walk up - the word; I push one (a jab) - the fist fight; the Docks' three draw when I draw at 15 m; the border fight (fists, then guns) seen from 30 m, the police car to it, no heat on me.
